questionText: When and through which legal mechanism was the Planning Commission of India originally established?

options.text: March 1950 by a simple resolution of the Union Cabinet
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Identifies Planning Commission established in March 1950 as an extra-constitutional body.

options.text: January 1950 through Article 371 of the Constitution

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option 'August 1947 by an act of the British Parliament'. Confuses powers or jurisdictions between different international or domestic organs (e.g. UN General Assembly vs Security Council, Planning Commission vs NITI Aayog).

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option 'December 1952 by a national popular referendum'. Attributes a political stance, manifesto promise, or slogan to the wrong party or political faction.

detailedSolution:
The Planning Commission was established in March 1950 by an executive resolution of the Government of India. It was not created by the Constitution or an act of Parliament, making it an extra-constitutional, advisory body.
